top_signals.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: The growing debate over video calls on airplanes, premium California wines selling at steep discounts under supermarket private labels, a new rivalry between New York diners featuring singing waiters and the growing popularity of elaborate tuna carving experiences at high-end sushi restaurants. Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
